From today, Runna subscription users can use the brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on the temperature and humidity of the user's location. Details are as follows.

Runna launches new training tool to help users cope with hot weather

The personalised running coach app Runna announced today the launch of three updates designed to support users throughout their entire training cycle, covering everything from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature officially launches today, helping users find cooler times to run and recommending adjusted pace targets based on felt-like temperature, workout duration and the specific training session.

The "Heat Adaptation" feature uses colour coding to distinguish the weather forecast for each time slot, allowing users to find the best time to run at a glance and plan their training accordingly.

The following is Runna's introduction of this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature. As soon as a user starts a 5K to 50K race plan, the system automatically generates a corresponding recovery plan. Steph Kessell, Runna's head coach and former Olympian, said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of overtraining or injury".

Finally, the platform announced a new feature called "Upcoming Plans" will launch in August. Users can pre-schedule multiple training plans, and the system will seamlessly transition between plans, further simplifying the long-term training process.

The following are the benefits of Runna's "Upcoming Plans" feature:

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: runners can stack races, mid-term goals and training phases for an at-a-glance overview of the whole year. Zero admin between plans: no need to rebuild or start from scratch — when one plan ends and the next begins, your preferred training schedule, estimated finish time and current fitness carry over automatically. Flexibility on your terms: every plan can be edited, swapped or deleted at any time, giving runners full control over their training experience. Built for progress: every plan is carefully designed by the Runna coaching team based on proven training principles to support sustainable progress, recovery and race-day performance.
